title: The open MLE-bench agents read at named commits: how they search, and where each would break DCLab's rules
request: The owner chose 'MLE-bench lessons 33.1–33.5': the plan's ideas came from leaderboards and READMEs, so before building more search the open agents' code had to be read.
spec: docs/guides/MLE_BENCH_AGENTS_STUDY.md: for MLEvolve, ML-Master v1, AIRA-dojo, R&D-Agent, AIDE and Kapso, their operators, search policy, memory, budget, validation and final choice, use of the test set, licence, and where each breaks a rule of Part C; MLExpert's recipe against the agentic model's plan; documentation only, no code copied or run.
plan: Read each repository at a commit named in the note: README, configuration, and the search, memory, execution and selection files.
Mark every claim resting on an unread paper as unverified.
Map each idea to what DCLab already has and say whether to build it under the rules.
Update the plan's statuses: 33.1 done, 33.2, 33.3 and 33.5 as phase 10 left them.

decisions.decision: The study was written by a research agent and checked here before it was committed.
decisions.why: A fresh reader of the code is less anchored on the plan's own summary of the agents.

decisions.decision: Agents without a licence or under a non-commercial one are ideas only.
decisions.why: The open edition is Apache-2.0; ML-Master has no licence file and AIRA-dojo is non-commercial.

decisions.decision: The plan's line on MLExpert is corrected: weights and the task factory, not code and weights.
decisions.why: Its repository at the commit read holds no harness and no training code.

change: New docs/guides/MLE_BENCH_AGENTS_STUDY.md; MLE_BENCH_LESSONS_PLAN.md: the status paragraph, 33.1 done with its findings, 33.2 built as 34.6, 33.3's search built as 34.7a (opt-in), 33.5 not built (34.7b), Part A's MLExpert row, and the Persian summary's status.

findings.defect: Two open agents keep a test-set signal inside the search.
findings.scenario: AIRA-dojo grades every valid submission on the test answers at each step, one flag away from steering the search; Kapso's handler stops the search when the test set awards a medal.
findings.cause: Their graders live in the search process for analysis or legacy stopping.
findings.fix: None to make in DCLab: the note records the rule that a grader sits outside any search and runs only on replicas or the sealed set.

findings.defect: The plan described MLExpert as releasing its code.
findings.scenario: A package planned on reusing MLExpert's harness would find nothing to reuse.
findings.cause: Part A was written from the announcement.
findings.fix: Part A's row now says weights and the task factory.

outcome: Every later MLE-bench package can cite where its idea comes from and which rule it must keep; the plan's statuses match what phase 10 built.
lessons: Read the code at a commit, not the README: the configuration that scored on a leaderboard is not always the one in the repository.
risks: The agents' papers were not read (arXiv was blocked), so what rests on them is marked unverified.
